title: Zero-Parameter Two-Doublet Law and the 10-Observable Flavour Readout

scope.frame: Coupling tensors on data-free 2-torsion line w = (2/5, 1/10) across B1757's strip and the exact arithmetic geodesic apex tau_* = (1 + i*sqrt(84))/3
scope.object: zero-parameter two-doublet laws (0 DOFs in H_u, 0 DOFs in H_d) built from Yukawa Gram operators and canonical de Rham form v_DR(tau), evaluated on 10 dimensionless flavour observables at M_Z and M_GUT = 10^12 GeV (P-329, P-357, P-363, P-366, P-377)
scope.hypotheses: SU(5) hypercharges (1,-4), (1,2), (-3,6); line w = (2/5, 1/10); Huang-Zhou (2021) GUT running

claim_one_line: ZERO-PARAMETER TWO-DOUBLET LAW AND 10-OBSERVABLE FLAVOUR READOUT (P-329, P-357, P-363, P-366, P-377): on data-free line w = (2/5, 1/10), the symmetric cubic parity identity strictly confines M^(up)_0 to 1+2 diagonal blocks and M^(up)_{1,2} to off-diagonal blocks; the zero-parameter two-doublet laws built from inverse-Gram operators and the up-sector Gram boost lambda_{(1,+i)}/lambda_{e1} ~ 1.981 reduce chi^2_nine from 567-1073 (single-Higgs v_DR) to 25.43-27.93 at M_Z and 24.94-26.99 at M_GUT with zero free Higgs parameters, matching the unconstrained 2-parameter numerical floor to within Delta chi^2 <= 0.74 and predicting the Jarlskog CP invariant at |J_CKM| = (2.13-3.09) x 10^-5 (within 0.09-2.46 sigma of PDG (3.08 +/- 0.15) x 10^-5 vs -20.5 sigma for single-Higgs v_DR). 0 of 19.
weave_or_thread: weave (structural theorem on symmetric cubic parity blocks; zero-parameter flavour readout at M_Z and M_GUT across the strip and at the exact arithmetic geodesic apex)
